red_text: the official’s narrow filled necktie and the signature squiggle on the upright document. Preserve both separate accents. Keep the paper on the desk, the face-free head and the upright document’s overlap.

red_text: the upper right-pointing arrow and the coin’s dollar sign. Boxes, coin outline and returning lower arrow stay black. Preserve the diagonal parcel edges and vertically separated opposing arrows.

red_text: the signal arcs, upper accent edges of the slanted ballot, warning triangle and its exclamation. Globe and ballot-box body stay black. Preserve the warning badge in front of the box.
